meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会依据你的实验需求，引导你在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上选择协议、准备输入文件并完成订购；也能借助 EstiMate 用自然语言描述定制实验，获得可行性评估与报价。
howto.when: 当用户提到要运行蛋白质表达、定量检测、RNA 合成等实验，或要求使用 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 提交协议时触发。

say.text: 我想在 Cloud Lab 上做细胞外蛋白质表达并纯化，该选哪个协议？
say.note: 会推荐合适的表达与纯化协议

say.text: 我想用 Echo-MS 检测酶反应产物，需要准备什么？
say.note: 会说明 Echo-MS 检测协议与输入要求

say.text: 用 EstiMate 帮我评估一个自定义实验的可行性
say.note: 会引导你描述实验并获得评估

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude guides you to choose a protocol, prepare inputs, and complete ordering on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, and can use EstiMate to describe custom experiments for feasibility and pricing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention wanting to run protein expression, quantification assays, RNA synthesis, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services.

say_en.text: I'd like to detect enzyme reaction products with Echo-MS. What do I need to prepare?
say_en.note: It will explain the Echo-MS protocol and input requirements.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to assess the feasibility of a custom experiment.
say_en.note: It will guide you to describe the experiment and get an assessment.
